Hi Mofuwa, I love your artwork! I had to euthanize my beloved cat named Smokey today. I would love to have memorial art of her, smiling similar to the art of the tuxedo and calico cats you did for Sakamoto-san. It would mean a great deal to me and my family to remember her in a loving way. Thank you!
